case_number: 2024 INSC 343; Criminal Appeal Nos.1957-1961 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) Nos.3484-3488 of 2024)
summary: Acid attack victim appeals against suspension of life sentence; Section 389 CrPC requires written reasons for suspension/bail; serious offenses demand rigorous assessment of factors: nature of crime, injury severity (30-40% burns), witness tampering risks, prima facie case; payment offer (Rs. 25 lakhs) insufficient grounds; non-application of mind in impugned order; appeals allowed.
final_judgment: Impugned order set aside; suspension of sentence and bail revoked; original life imprisonment restored.
